arxiv-2201-03034.title: Kurosh theorem for certain Koszul Lie algebras
arxiv-2201-03034.creator: Simone Blumer Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
arxiv-2201-03034.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Simone Blumer Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca. The Kurosh theorem for groups provides the structure of any subgroup of a free product of groups and its proof relies on Bass-Serre theory of groups acting on trees. In the case of Lie algebras, such a general theory does not exists and the Kurosh theorem is false in general, as it was first noticed by Shirshov in [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2211-00780.title: Predicting Air Quality via Multimodal AI and Satellite Imagery Journal: Elsevier
arxiv-2211-00780.creator: Andrew Rowley, Oktay Karakuş
arxiv-2211-00780.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Andrew Rowley, Oktay Karakuş. One of the most important major driving forces behind climate change and environmental issues that the Earth is currently facing is the pollution of the air which remains a key symptom of negative human influence on the environment. Air pollution is often invisible to the eye which can make its detection challenging, unlike the destruction of the land or waterways. Given that air-quality monitoring stations are typically ground-based, their abilities to detect pollutant distributions are often restricted to wide areas.

arxiv-2211-14749.description: Abstract . For a prime power q q , 𝔽 q \mathbb{F}_{q} denotes the finite field of order q q , and for m ≥ 2 m\geq 2 , 𝔽 q m \mathbb{F}_{q^{m}} denotes the extension field of degree m m .

arxiv-2307-14455.title: Spatial orientation of the fission fragment intrinsic spins and their correlations
arxiv-2307-14455.creator: Guillaume Scamps, Ibrahim Abdurrahman, Matthew Kafker, Aurel Bulgac, Ionel Stetcu
arxiv-2307-14455.description: Abstract New experimental and theoretical results obtained in 2021 made it acutely clear that more than 80 years after the discovery of nuclear fission we do not understand the generation and dynamics of fission fragment (FF) intrinsic spins well, in particular their magnitudes, their spatial orientation, and their correlations.

arxiv-2401-07605.title: Gradient conformal stationarity and the CMC condition in LRS spacetimes
arxiv-2401-07605.creator: Gareth Amery, Peter K S Dunsby, Abbas M Sherif
arxiv-2401-07605.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gareth Amery, Peter K S Dunsby, Abbas M Sherif. We study the existence of gradient conformal Killing vectors (CKVs) in the class of locally rotationally symmetric (LRS) spacetimes which generalizes spherically symmetric spacetimes, and investigate some implications for the evolutionary character of marginally outer trapped surfaces. We first study existence of gradient CKVs via the obtention of a relationship between the Ricci curvature and the gradient of the divergence of the CKV.

arxiv-2404-09189.title: The Witt groups of extended quadratic forms over ℤ \mathbb{Z}
arxiv-2404-09189.creator: Diarmuid Crowley, Csaba Nagy
arxiv-2404-09189.description: Abstract . We study quadratic form parameters Q Q over the integers and extended quadratic forms with values in Q Q , which we call Q Q -forms . Certain form parameters Q Q appeared in Wall’s work on the classification of almost closed ( n − 1 ) (n{-}1) -connected 2 ​ n 2n -manifolds via Q Q -forms.

arxiv-2410-14575.title: Analysis of an asymptotic thermo fluid-dynamic model for parabolic trough power plants
arxiv-2410-14575.creator: G. M. Coclite, I. Gasser
arxiv-2410-14575.description: Abstract . Parabolic trough power plants transform solar radiative energy into thermal energy which is then typically used to produce electricity. We consider a model derived in [ 3 ] to describe parabolic trough power plants. In particular, the thermo-fluid dynamics is studied in a single collector pipe where the solar radiation is concentrated.

arxiv-2504-16122.title: SOTOPIA-S 4 : a user-friendly system for flexible, customizable, and large-scale social simulation
arxiv-2504-16122.creator: Xuhui Zhou ♡ Zhe Su ♡ Sophie Feng ♡ Jiaxu Zhou ♠
arxiv-2504-16122.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xuhui Zhou ♡ Zhe Su ♡ Sophie Feng ♡ Jiaxu Zhou ♠. Social simulation through large language model (LLM) agents is a promising approach to explore and validate hypotheses related to social science questions and LLM agents behavior. We present SOTOPIA-S 4 , a fast, flexible, and scalable social simulation system that addresses the technical barriers of current frameworks while enabling practitioners to generate multi-turn and multi-party LLM-based interactions with customizable evaluation metrics for hypothesis testing.

arxiv-2510-27406.title: Muon veto system for the CROSS double-beta decay search experiment
arxiv-2510-27406.creator: and A. Zolotarova
arxiv-2510-27406.description: Abstract In preparation to the CROSS experiment at the Canfranc underground laboratory (Spain) — aiming to search for neutrinoless double-beta ( 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta ) decay of 100 Mo using low-temperature detectors with heat-scintillation readout — we report on development of a dedicated muon veto system.

pmc-10689187.title: Increased expression of SCARF genes favoring SARS-CoV-2 infection in key target organs in CKD
pmc-10689187.creator: Sol Carriazo, Marta Ribagorda, Aranzazu Pintor-Chocano, Maria Vanessa Perez-Gomez, Alberto Ortiz, Maria Dolores Sanchez-Niño
pmc-10689187.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD), especially diabetic CKD, is the condition that most increases the risk of lethal coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). However, the underlying molecular mechanisms are unclear. SARS-CoV-2 and coronavirus-associated receptors and factors (SCARFs) regulate coronavirus cell entry and/or replication.

pmc-11467197.title: Distance based topological characterization, graph energy prediction, and NMR patterns of benzene ring embedded in P-type surface in 2D network
pmc-11467197.creator: Xiujun Zhang, S. Prabhu, M. Arulperumjothi, S. Manikanda Prabhu, Micheal Arockiaraj, V. Manimozhi
pmc-11467197.description: Nanostructures are tiny objects at the molecular and microscopic scale, with carbon nanotubes being the most notable among them. The elements possess exceptional microelectronic properties and other unique characteristics. Researchers have recently focused on the mathematical features of these materials. Molecular descriptors are crucial in mathematical chemistry, particularly in QSAR and QSPR modeling.

pmc-11584427.title: ASPP2 deficiency attenuates lipid accumulation through the PPARγ pathway in alcoholic liver injury
pmc-11584427.creator: Ying Zhang, Xingzhong Miao, Fang Liu, Honglin Shi, Dexi Chen, Yu Chen, Yingmin Ma, Hongbo Shi
pmc-11584427.description: The initial stage of alcoholic liver disease (ALD) is hepatic steatosis. Recent studies have highlighted a possible role for Apoptosis-stimulating protein 2 of p53 (ASPP2) in regulating hepatic lipid metabolism in nonalcoholic fatty liver (NAFLD). However, whether ASPP2 regulates alcohol-induced lipid accumulation and its mechanisms remain unclear.

pmc-11655590.title: 5956 German affective norms for atmospheres in organizations (GANAiO)
pmc-11655590.creator: Anna Eifert, Christian Julmi
pmc-11655590.description: This article develops a comprehensive database comprising 5956 German affective norms specifically tailored for the study of organizational atmospheres through computational verbal language analysis. This dictionary adopts both dimensional and categorical approaches. The theoretical foundation of this study is the circumplex model of affective atmospheres.

pmc-11664914.title: Atomic-Scale Imaging of Polymers and Precision Molecular Weight Analysis
pmc-11664914.creator: Arkadios Marathianos, Alexandros Magiakos, Yisong Han, Ana Sanchez, Richard Whitfield, Jochen Kammerer, Athina Anastasaki, Paul Wilson, Joseph P Patterson, Christopher Barner-Kowollik, Evelina Liarou
pmc-11664914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Polymer design requires fine control over syntheses and a thorough understanding of their macromolecular structure. Herein, near-atomic level imaging of polymers is achieved, enabling the precise determination of one of the most important macromolecular characteristics: molecular weight. By judiciously designing and synthesizing different linear metal(loid)-rich homopolymers, subnanoscale polymer imaging is achieved through annular dark field-scanning transmission electron microscopy (ADF-STEM), owing to the incorporation of high Z atoms in the side chain of the monomeric units.

pmc-12438662.title: Perspectives of Family Caregivers of People With Alzheimer’s Disease on Caregiving Experience and Needs: A Qualitative Study
pmc-12438662.creator: B. Şentürk Kılıç, D. Hiçdurmaz, Y. Ayhan, E. Saka
pmc-12438662.description: IntroductionOver 55 million people currently have Alzheimer’s disease (AD), with estimates predicting a rise to 78 million by 2030. The burden of AD impacts not only the affected individuals but also their families and society due to the increasing care demands. Caring for people with AD is emotionally and physically taxing.

pmc-12448485.title: Bone union achieved in an ulnar shaft nonunion using dextrose prolotherapy without surgery: a case report
pmc-12448485.creator: Shinnosuke Hada, Kengo Sugitani, Hiroaki Kanazawa, Muneaki Ishijima
pmc-12448485.description: Prolotherapy, involving hypertonic dextrose injections to stimulate growth factor release and promote tissue healing, has recently gained attention as a regenerative treatment for refractory musculoskeletal conditions. We report a 54-year-old man with a painful ulnar shaft nonunion after a karate injury. Conservative treatment failed over 12 months, and he presented with persistent pain (numeric rating scale [NRS] score 6).

pmc-12537361.title: Article antidiabetic potential of peanut oil: inhibiting α-amylase and α-glucosidase using identified phytochemicals through in vitro and in silico studies
pmc-12537361.creator: Djamila Benouchenne, Hanène Djeghim, Ouided Benslama, Huda Alsaeedi, David Cornu, Mikhael Bechelany, Ahmed Barhoum
pmc-12537361.description: BackgroundPeanut oil is recognized for its mild flavor, high phytochemical content, medicinal potential, and other health advantages.ObjectiveThis study, for the first time, evaluates the antidiabetic potential of peanut oil, known for its high phytochemical content and medicinal properties.MethodsThe oil, collected from the El Oued region of Algeria, was extracted using the Soxhlet technique with n-hexane as the solvent.

pmc-13099389.title: Efficacy and safety of ABBV-154 in patients with moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease: a phase 2b, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
pmc-13099389.creator: Walter Reinisch, Laurent Peyrin-Biroulet, Geert D’Haens, Andreas Sturm, Jaclyn K Anderson, Izabella Messina, Dilek Arikan, Alissa Zimmerman-Bennett, Julie Parmentier, Tian Feng, Ronilda D’Cunha, Andreas Lazar, Edouard Louis
pmc-13099389.description: BackgroundABBV-154 is an antibody-drug conjugate of adalimumab and a proprietary glucocorticoid receptor modulator. This phase 2b randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of ABBV-154 versus placebo in patients with moderately to severely active Crohn’s disease who had inadequate response to or were intolerant of prior biologic therapy.

pmc-13163361.title: Comparative Analysis of Physicochemical Properties, Antioxidant and Enzyme Inhibitory Activities of Sporoderm-Broken Ganoderma lucidum Spore Powders from Different Regions in China
pmc-13163361.creator: Jingxiao Li, Ru Li, Huabin Zhou, Hang Qu, Bo Chen, Hailong Yang
pmc-13163361.description: Ganoderma lucidum spore powder is widely recognized as a high-grade Ganoderma product and is extensively consumed as a functional food and dietary supplement in China. To compare quality differences, nine batches of sporoderm-broken G. lucidum spore powders (DX, SD, FJ, JL, XZ, LQ, AH, LN, and GZ) were collected from representative producing regions across China.

pmc-13257419.title: TRPV4-Dependent Epithelial Mechanoadaptation and Barrier Remodeling Mediate Sennoside-Induced Distal Colonic Motility
pmc-13257419.creator: Yusuke Hara, Rei Kawashima, Shun Tamaki, Tatsunori Maekawa, Yuki I. Kawamura, Taizo Tsujimoto, Chika Kusano, Takafumi Ichikawa
pmc-13257419.description: Improvement of bowel function is accompanied by increased luminal flow and altered epithelial mechanical forces, yet the underlying epithelial mechanisms remain unclear. We investigated whether enhanced luminal stimulation is associated with epithelial mechanotransduction and junctional remodeling during changes in colonic motility. Sennoside was orally administered at 4.

pmc-13284525.title: Summary of the Safety Assessment Data of the Most Common Organogermanium Food Ingredient, Asaigermanium (Poly‐trans‐[(2‐carboxyethyl)germasesquioxane])
pmc-13284525.creator: Sota Doiyama, Takashi Nakamura
pmc-13284525.description: Asaigermanium is a water‐soluble organogermanium compound created by Kazuhiko Asai and colleagues in 1967. It was first researched and developed decades ago as a pharmaceutical product, but it is now used as a raw material for food supplements and cosmetics.

pmc-13380225.title: Formation of characteristic aroma compounds in walnut kernels during thermal processing and their potential recognition by human olfactory receptors
pmc-13380225.creator: Yishen Cheng, Shanxing Gao, Lei Zhang, Chenyan Lv, Jiachen Zang
pmc-13380225.description: Walnut (Juglans regia L.) is an oil-rich nut valued for its nutritional quality and characteristic flavor. Different thermal processing methods, including roasting, microwave treatment, and stir-frying, may shape walnut sensory perception by altering the composition and abundance of key aroma compounds and thereby influencing their differential interactions with human olfactory receptors. However, these relationships remain insufficiently understood.

pmc-13420644.title: From High-Risk to High-Reward
pmc-13420644.creator: Kathrin Trame, Hazem Omran
pmc-13420644.description: Corresponding Author Transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) has evolved from a therapy for inoperable patients to a standard of care across the surgical risk spectrum. As indications broaden and procedural volumes rise worldwide, the absolute number of rare but serious complications inevitably increases. Prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE) following TAVR is among the most challenging complications.
